title: Lugares de la ciudad
communication_goal: Nombrar lugares comunes de una ciudad y decir dónde están.
situation: Preguntas por un servicio o describes un lugar cerca de tu casa.

vocabulary.example: The bank is near the station.
The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The hospital is on Main Street.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is there a supermarket near here?

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, there is. The supermarket is next to the pharmacy.
dialogue.spanish: Sí. El supermercado está al lado de la farmacia.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: It is across from the park, on Main Street.
dialogue.spanish: Está enfrente del parque, en la calle Main.

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.english: Yes, there is a library downtown.
dialogue.spanish: Sí, hay una biblioteca en el centro.

explanation_es: Para preguntar por la existencia de un lugar usa Is there a...? o Are there any...? Para ubicarlo usa The bank is near the station. Las expresiones near, next to y across from describen relaciones entre lugares. Downtown significa en el centro de la ciudad.
spanish_speaker_notes: Near here significa cerca de aquí; no uses near to aquí.
Across from equivale a enfrente de, no cruzando desde literalmente.
The bank is... ubica un lugar conocido; There is a bank... presenta uno nuevo.
Pharmacy contiene varias sílabas; practícala lentamente.

targets.text: Is there a supermarket near here?
The pharmacy is next to the bank.
It is across from the park.

pronunciation.tip_es: Al pedir una dirección, empieza con Excuse me para llamar la atención de forma cortés.

reading.title: A useful neighborhood
reading.text: There is a supermarket next to a pharmacy. The bank is across from a park on Main Street. There is also a library downtown. The hospital is near the park.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada lugar con una actividad o necesidad.
Escucha: The pharmacy is next to the bank. Elige la relación.
activities.audio_text: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
options: La farmacia está al lado del banco.
La farmacia está dentro del banco.
La farmacia está lejos del banco.
activities.correct: La farmacia está al lado del banco.

activities.feedback: Library es singular y usa Is there.
Where is pregunta la ubicación de un lugar.

activities.instruction: Corrige: The bank is in front the park.
activities.answer: The bank is across from the park.
activities.feedback: Across from necesita from y expresa enfrente de.

activities.instruction: Describe tres lugares de un barrio usando near, next to y across from.
activities.target: The ... is near ... The ... is next to ... The ... is across from ...

activities.instruction: Lee A Useful Neighborhood y responde: Where is the hospital?
activities.feedback: La última oración indica su ubicación.

activities.instruction: La IA será un visitante nuevo. Explica dónde están cuatro lugares de un barrio ficticio.
activities.scenario: Describing useful places in a neighborhood.
activities.ai_language: English; ask follow-up questions about nearby places

activities.instruction: Crea un mapa sencillo con seis lugares y graba ocho frases sobre sus ubicaciones.
Completa: lugar para comida = ___; medicinas = ___; libros = ___; enfrente de = across ___.

must_demonstrate: usar there is y where is
mastery_criteria.retry: Si confundes los lugares, asocia cada uno con una necesidad concreta antes de describir el mapa.
